statement.text:
Prove that every standard homomorphism Λ of En (R) ⊂ GLn (R) = GL(V )
into Em (S) ⊂ GLm (S) = GL(W ) originates from a collineation and a correlation,
that is, has the form Λx = (g −1 xg)f + (h−1 xh)(1 − f ), where g is a semilinear
isomorphism VR → WS (collineation) and h is a semilinear isomorphism VR →S WS′ 0
(correlation).                                                    V. M. Petechuk
